snippet.title: MAIL MOLE: COLLECTOR'S EDITION THIS JUNE 17, 2022
snippet.description:
Moving underground, climbing huge walls and soaring the skies, there’s no place our hero can’t reach! 

Travelling with Cannon Lines, Molty will need to overcome the most complicated challenges to reach Carrotland‘s furthestmailboxes: bottomless pits, quicksands, avalanches, floating platforms, sharp spikes... a tough road. But when the power is out, you can’t send an email!
